comment: The menu bar the application must have, taken from the public Media Composer 2024/2025 documentation.
tst_menu_inventory compares the real menu bar against this file: every menu, item, separator and default shortcut.
Shortcuts use Qt portable text; Ctrl means Command on macOS.
STATUS: provisional. Only the Phase 0 menus are listed. The full inventory is entered from the Media Composer
Editing Guide (docs/spec/ui-inventory.md) and each entry cites its page.
